# Event 1: Exile-Only Crisis Opening — The Fourth Odyssey: Sail Toward the Setting Sun
oe_ely.1 = {
	type = country_event
	title = oe_ely.1.title
	desc = oe_ely.1.desc
	outcome = neutral
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_byz_siege_walls.dds"

	trigger = {
		NOT = { oe_ely_rule_is_off = yes }
		is_ai = no
		oe_ely_eligible_tag = yes
		NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ely_settled }
		NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ely_odyssey_launched }
	}

	immediate = {
		oe_ml_take = yes
		set_variable = { name = oe_ely_ev_1_done value = 1 }
	}

	# Option A: Launch Project Ark (activates oe_sit_fourth_odyssey)
	option = {
		name = oe_ely.1.a
		custom_tooltip = oe_ely.1.a.tt
		oe_ely_init_voyage = yes
		ai_chance = { base = 0 }
	}

	# Option B: Stand fast in the Old World (zero interference with oe_l7)
	option = {
		name = oe_ely.1.b
		custom_tooltip = oe_ely.1.b.tt
		set_variable = { name = oe_ely_declined value = 1 }
		add_stability = stability_weak_bonus
		ai_chance = { base = 100 }
	}
}

# Event 130: Hidden instant landfall shell-swap worker (keeps oe_ely.13 option preview dry-run at 0 errors).
oe_ely.130 = {
	type = country_event
	hidden = yes
	interface_lock = no
	title = empty_text
	outcome = neutral

	trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ely_settled }
		oe_ely_chesapeake_claimable = yes
	}

	immediate = {
		oe_ely_complete_landfall_setup = yes
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:oe_ely_new_realm }
			if = {
				limit = { is_ai = no }
				change_player = scope:oe_ely_new_realm
			}
			oe_ely_dissolve_old_host = yes
		}
	}
}

# Event 14: Post-Landfall (+6m) — First Winter in Elysia: Maize and Rye
oe_ely.14 = {
	type = country_event
	title = oe_ely.14.title
	desc = oe_ely.14.desc
	outcome = negative
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_byz_diplomacy.dds"

	trigger = {
		has_global_variable = oe_ely_settled
		oe_ely_is_elysian_host = yes
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_ely_winter_done }
	}

	immediate = {
		oe_ml_take = yes
		set_variable = { name = oe_ely_ev_14_done value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_ely_winter_done value = 1 }
	}

	# Option A: Receive maize seed and winter counsel from friendly Nansemond / Powhatan neighbors
	option = {
		name = oe_ely.14.a
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				var:oe_ely_first_contact ?= 1
				has_variable = oe_ely_native_goodwill
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = oe_ely.14.a.tt
		save_temporary_scope_as = oe_ely_host
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_ely_maize_adaptation_mod
			years = 25
			mode = replace
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = c:TSN
				c:TSN = { country_type = pop }
			}
			c:TSN = {
				add_opinion = {
					modifier = opinion_good_relations
					target = scope:oe_ely_host
				}
			}
		}
		ai_chance = { base = 80 }
	}

	# Option B: Ration shipboard stores and pay imperial bullion to survive the frost
	option = {
		name = oe_ely.14.b
		custom_tooltip = oe_ely.14.b.tt
		add_gold = -45
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_ely_winter_rationing_mod
			years = 10
			mode = replace
		}
		ai_chance = { base = 20 }
	}
}

	title = oe_ely.15.title
	desc = oe_ely.15.desc
	outcome = positive
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_byz_senate_consistorium.dds"

	trigger = {
		has_global_variable = oe_ely_settled
		oe_ely_is_elysian_host = yes
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_ely_charter_proclaimed }
	}

	immediate = {
		oe_ml_take = yes
		set_variable = { name = oe_ely_ev_15_done value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_ely_charter_proclaimed value = 1 }
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_ely.15.a
		custom_tooltip = oe_ely.15.a.tt
		add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus
		culture = {
			add_cultural_tradition = cultural_tradition_mild_bonus
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = oe_ely_relic_score
				var:oe_ely_relic_score >= 4
			}
			add_country_modifier = {
				modifier = oe_ely_relic_golden_legacy_mod
				years = -1
				mode = replace
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = oe_ely_relic_score
				var:oe_ely_relic_score >= 2
			}
			add_country_modifier = {
				modifier = oe_ely_relic_preserved_legacy_mod
				years = -1
				mode = replace
			}
		}
		else = {
			add_country_modifier = {
				modifier = oe_ely_relic_humble_start_mod
				years = -1
				mode = replace
			}
		}
		ai_chance = { base = 100 }
	}
}

# Event 16: Read-only Diagnostic Telemetry Readout (for Dev Panel & L3 Audit; zero state mutation)
oe_ely.16 = {
	type = country_event
	title = oe_ely.16.title
	desc = oe_ely.16.desc
	outcome = neutral
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_byz_senate_consistorium.dds"

	trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_ely.16.a
		ai_chance = { base = 100 }
	}
}
